mechanism: Adapalene may increase skin photosensitivity and irritation while candesartan can cause photosensitivity; concurrent use increases risk of severe dermatologic adverse effects and potential for additive photosensitivity reactions.
action: Counsel patients on strict sun protection measures including broad-spectrum sunscreen (SPF ≥30), protective clothing, and consideration of timing adjustments for adapalene application during candesartan therapy.
